frequency_question: How often does a proposed central bank pricing framework reach final circular issuance and enforcement within the specified deadline after initial proposal?
membership_rule: Includes all formal consultative papers or proposed frameworks concerning interest rates, pricing limits, or fee caps issued by the central banking authority. Excludes general monetary policy rate announcements and prudential norms not focused on direct pricing/fees.

cases.name: Credit card billing and pricing norms

coverage_note: 7 named cases covering the last decade of central banking pricing interventions in this jurisdiction.
known_gaps: Minor technical circular clarifications omitted as they are subsets of main frameworks.
skeleton: Total regulatory pricing proposals advanced to draft stage divided by those fully issued and enforced within the target timeframe.
multiplier: 6 hits out of 7 total comparable regulatory proposals
validity_reason: Based on current regulatory leadership tenure and institutional rulemaking pace, which remains stable through the forecast window.
